sn12.93-103:1.1: karaṇīyā → karaṇīyāti (bj); karaṇīyā evaṁ (sya-all); karaṇīya evam (pts)

sn12.203-213:3.4: peyyālaantaramhi → peyyāle antaramhi (bj); peyyālā antaramhi (sya-all) | yeti antarapeyyālesu → ye antarapeyyāle hi (pts) | yeti → peyyālā antaramhi yeti (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ.)
